newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 4.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following business stories on Dec. 4:
WASHINGTON - The Clinton administration is willing to consider proposals to significantly scale back the annual cost-of-living adjustment used to set payments for federal benefit programs.

WASHINGTON - The District of Columbia's public service commission approved new discounted rates that Bell Atlantic Corp. must charge rivals for leasing its telephone lines to provide competing local phone service.
WASHINGTON - James P. Hoffa, son of the late Teamster president, appears to be in a neck-and-neck race with incumbent Ron Carey for the presidency of the huge union.
WASHINGTON - Charles Freeman has helped steer the $16.5 billion Vanguard Windsor Fund to a 27.1 percent return through November, beating the Standard & Poor's 500-stock index, up 25.2 percent.
WASHINGTON - A Rossyln investment banking firm announced the launch of a $25 million venture-capital fund that will invest in emerging high-technology companies in the Washington region.
